theorems.name: Submission.tae_mult_lusin_compact_pieces
theorems.statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} {U : Set (Amb n ℓ)} (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), IsOpen U → ∃ C : ℕ → Set (Amb n ℓ), (∀ i, IsCompact (C i) ∧ C i ⊆ V.carrier ∧ ContinuousOn V.mult (C i)) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (V.carrier \ ⋃ i, C i) = 0
